## Description

/inbox: rows with severity (Critical/Abnormal/Normal, icon + word), patient, test, time, loop state (Received · not reviewed → Reviewed → Assigned → Released → Completed). Detail: analyte, value, range, flag, previous value, source and match basis; optional AI context note (dashed, not reviewed). "Mark as reviewed" stores actor/time (REVIEW_ACKNOWLEDGEMENT); Assign follow-up and Release to patient unlock only after review; release follows release rules (doctor controls what/when).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Assign and Release are impossible before review (server-enforced).
- [ ] **AC2.** Critical results unreviewed after a configurable time escalate (notification to the doctor and covering clinician).
- [ ] **AC3.** A patient never sees a result before the doctor releases it (portal test; NFR 3).
- [ ] **AC4.** Pilot report shows 0 abnormal results unacknowledged > 72 h (exit gate 3) or lists breaches with actions.
